sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Jade Dancer and Iron Fiend is an optional encounter in Crimson Manor & Crimson Forest, found at Crimson Forest. Beating it yields Fiend Saws (via the Mu Xiaokui encounter).

sections.title: Where to Find the Jade Dancer and Iron Fiend
sections.content:
Location: Crimson Forest.

Appears in: Crimson Manor & Crimson Forest.

sections.title: Weaknesses and Counters
sections.content:
There is no weakness table for this fight because there is no damage-type system to fill one in: nothing here resists, absorbs or is immune to anything, and a chart that says otherwise has been inferred from how the boss looks. Read the fight by attack colour instead - red must be dodged, blue must be deflected, purple means it has just parried you and a counter is already coming. The full explanation is on the combat system.

It is optional, which is why it can be left until the Sha-Chi pool and the Phantom Edge roster are deeper.

sections.title: Rewards
sections.content: • Fiend Saws (via the Mu Xiaokui encounter)

sections.title: How to Beat the Jade Dancer and Iron Fiend
sections.content:
What works

  • Two guardians at once - keep both in frame and never let them bracket you.
  • Kill order matters more than damage output here.

sections.title: Status
sections.content: No. 14 of 60 in the progression order, in Crimson Manor & Crimson Forest. Before it: Bai Chilian, Lady of the Twin Serpents (双蛇夫人 白赤练). After it: Yucong, the Twisted Puppet (No. 34). The roster by region is on the boss list, and the fights that can be lost by leaving a region early are on the order page. Location and drops come from the shipped game; patch 1.0302256 is the most recent change to any boss behaviour and it touched only Hua.
